detailed_description: The Image Format Converter helps you switch local images between PNG, JPEG, and WebP without leaving the browser. Upload a file, choose the target format, adjust quality for JPEG or WebP, and compare the original with the converted preview before downloading the result. It is useful for preparing lighter website assets, creating email-friendly JPEGs, or checking how the same image looks across common web formats in a quick one-page workflow.
usage_steps: Upload an image from your device to load the original preview.
Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP as the target format.
If you select JPEG or WebP, adjust the quality slider to balance size and clarity.
Run the conversion and compare the converted preview with the original image.
Download the converted file once the result looks right.
usage_examples: Convert a PNG screenshot to JPEG for a smaller email attachment.
Export a logo or UI asset as WebP for a faster landing page.
Compare PNG, JPEG, and WebP outputs before publishing an image-heavy page.
